lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: Greetings, traveler. I’m surprised you managed to enter our village. It is said to be closed to outsiders.

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: Thank you for delivering the letter, but I’m afraid you may be in trouble now. Everyone who has ever entered this village has become trapped here.

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: Try continuing down the road to the west. Perhaps you’ll manage to leave the village. If not… come back to me again.

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: I’ve already told you — head west from here. May God bless you, so that you do not fall into the trap we ourselves have fallen into.

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: Hmm. It seems you, too, have fallen into this time loop. No one can leave our village. All roads lead back to it.

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: Listen closely... A stray cat slipped into my chambers. I fear for my belongings... the creature looks mischievous, and my curios are far too fragile for its claws. Help me catch it, won't you?

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: Hmm. It seems you, too, have fallen into this time loop. No one can leave our village. All roads lead back to it.

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: Ah, since you’ve made yourself at my home... you see our uninvited guest? A cat. I don't trust the look in its eyes—my research, my precious records, they are all at risk. Please, corner the beast before it shreds my life's work.

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: That feline is the bane of my sanity! Please, lend a hand!

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: She’s a blur! Don't just stand there—do something!

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: Ou know... when she sleeps, she almost looks innocent. Charming, even. I believe I shall keep her. But enough of this sentimentality! We must return to the gravity of our situation. Have you noticed the void mist hanging over the house to the east?.

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: The books speak of an order of guardians who possess knowledge of how to fight this affliction.

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: A... radical solution, to be sure. I haven't the faintest inkling of what you just did, but the cat is gone. Vanished into thin air. I can only hope she didn't suffer... wherever 'there' is.

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: But we must return to the our situation. Have you noticed the void mist hanging over the house to the east?

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: The books speak of an order of guardians who possess knowledge of how to fight this affliction.

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: We need to summon a guardian to the village. Guard once lived here, but no one remembers them anymore, and no one knows where to find them.

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: I can hear from the far end of the village that a guardian has already arrived at the house consumed by the void.

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: Go there and speak with him. He will help us with the void mist.

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: Then the curse is real. I’ve heard that in the old house to the southwest—the one with the blocked entrance—there might be a book hidden in one of the chests. It could hold the answer to breaking this spell.

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: I can’t enter the house myself, but I know you can. It might be a long way, but it’s worth a try.

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: You have found the book of ancient lore! It is just as we thought. It says this house was once known as the 'assembly-hall.'

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: If it has been corrupted, then it must be restored. Onward, then!

lines.name: Village Elder
lines.text: Behind that Void lies the assembly-hall. How did I not remember that! Quick, we need to find a way to bring this place back.
